newsitem.title: FRANCE: Credit Commercial falls on downgrade.
newsitem.headline: Credit Commercial falls on downgrade.

text.p: Shares in bank Credit Commercial de France (CCF) fell on Monday following a downgrade to neutral from outperform by broker SGE Delahaye, fund managers said.
The SGE Delahaye analyst was not immediately available for comment. Fund managers said the analyst thought the shares were fully valued at their present level.
The stock was down 0.89 percent at 254.7 francs at 1304 GMT, on volume of 101,568 shares. The market was up 0.21 percent.
Broker Massonaud ABN Amro last Thursday raised its rating on CCF to buy from neutral and considered 270 francs a fair target.
